description: The devotee NAME is truncated with whiteSpace:nowrap + textOverflow:ellipsis instead of wrapping; long names get cut off, violating the no-ellipsis-on-content rule.
currentCode: {a.devoteeName || "—"}
suggestedFix: {a.devoteeName || "—"}

description: Subtitle line carrying appointmentType (real content) uses whiteSpace:nowrap + textOverflow:ellipsis; appointment type text gets clipped at narrow widths instead of wrapping.
currentCode: {fmtTime(a.checkedInAt)} · {a.appointmentType}
suggestedFix: {fmtTime(a.checkedInAt)} · {a.appointmentType}

description: The date/time input has no width:100% and no box-sizing:border-box. The media query forces width:100% but without box-sizing the 12px horizontal padding + 1.5px borders push it past its container at 250px, causing overflow. Its wrapping <div> also has no width.
currentCode:
<input type="datetime-local" value={bookWhen} onChange={e => setBookWhen(e.target.value)}
                      style={{ height: 38, padding: "0 12px", borderRadius: 9, border: "1.5px solid #e5e7eb", fontSize: 13, color: "#1f2937", outline: "none" }} />
suggestedFix:
<input type="datetime-local" value={bookWhen} onChange={e => setBookWhen(e.target.value)}
                      style={{ height: 38, padding: "0 12px", borderRadius: 9, border: "1.5px solid #e5e7eb", fontSize: 13, color: "#1f2937", outline: "none", width: "100%", maxWidth: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" }} />
// and give the wrapping <div> at line 402 style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}

section: Book-next inline form — Mode FancySelect minWidth
description: containerStyle sets minWidth:200 on the Mode dropdown. At a 250px viewport (inner content < 250px after the 14px form padding) a 200px min-width plus the date input and Book button forces horizontal overflow; the dropdown cannot shrink to stack.
suggestedFix:
containerStyle={{ marginBottom: 0, minWidth: 0, width: "100%", flex: 1 }}
// and wrap the FancySelect's parent <div> (line 407) with style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, width: "100%" }}

section: Book-next inline form — wrapping divs not flexible
description: Inside the .gd-booknext-form flex row, the two field wrapper <div>s (date input wrapper at 402, FancySelect wrapper at 407) have no flex/min-width:0, so even though the form wraps via media query, the children retain intrinsic widths and the 200px select + date input can overflow 250px. Children need flex:1 / min-width:0 to actually shrink.
currentCode:
<div className="gd-booknext-form" style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 12, padding: "14px 24px", background: "#f0fdfa", borderBottom: "1px solid #cbeae3" }}>
                  <div>
                    <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: "#0f766e", marginBottom: 5 }}>Date & Time</label>
suggestedFix: Add flex-wrap to the row and make children shrinkable: container style add flexWrap:"wrap"; wrap each field <div> with style={{ flex: "1 1 160px", minWidth: 0 }}. (Container already gets flex-wrap via the media query, but add minWidth:0 to the child divs so they shrink below 250px.)

description: gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr' with no media-query stack. Three fields side-by-side (Date/Time/Place of Birth) cannot fit at 250px; each track collapses to ~75px and field values overflow / squash.
currentCode:
<div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
                          <Field label="Date of Birth" value={linkedCase.dob} />
                          <Field label="Time of Birth" value={linkedCase.tob} />
                          <Field label="Place of Birth" value={linkedCase.pob} />
suggestedFix:
<div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>
// or add a media query at <=480px setting grid-template-columns:1fr

section: CASE / VISIT tab — Remedy Duration/Place 2-column grid
description: gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr' with no responsive stack. At 250px the two remedy fields are forced into two ~115px columns, squashing values instead of stacking.
currentCode:
<div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
                          <Field label="Remedy Duration" value={linkedCase.remedy_duration} />
                          <Field label="Remedy Place"    value={linkedCase.remedy_place} />
suggestedFix:
<div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>
// or media query at <=480px -> grid-template-columns:1fr

description: The tab bar uses overflowX:'auto' with whiteSpace:'nowrap' tab buttons (line 436), producing horizontal sideways scrolling of the 5 tabs at narrow widths instead of wrapping. Rule 1 forbids overflowX:auto producing horizontal scroll.
currentCode: <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, padding: "0 18px", background: "#fff", borderBottom: "1px solid #e5e7eb", flexShrink: 0, overflowX: "auto" }}>
suggestedFix:
<div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 4, padding: "0 14px", background: "#fff", borderBottom: "1px solid #e5e7eb", flexShrink: 0 }}>
// remove overflowX:auto; let tabs wrap to a second line
